## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D top-down fantasy survival game inspired by the Game of Thrones setting.

## Requirements
- 2D top-view style.
- Complete and playable, with no clarification needed.
- Responsive support for desktop and mobile.
- Include screenshots for visual verification.

## Decisions
- Used an original fan-made Winterfell/“The North Remembers” theme with no direct copyrighted assets.
- Implemented keyboard and touch controls.
- Added three objectives, enemies, a boss, combat abilities, health, minimap, and win/lose states.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a complete single-page game in `index.html`.
- Added title screen, objective HUD, minimap, health UI, and victory/defeat screens.
- Added movement, sword attacks, dragonfire, rolling, enemy AI, boss combat, and rally interactions.
- Added responsive mobile controls and layout.
- Validated JavaScript syntax.
- Created a desktop title screenshot at `screenshots/title.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Browser automation could not launch through `playwright-cli` because the Playwright Chromium executable was not installed.
- Visual verification used the system Chromium headless fallback instead.

## Next Move
1. Launch the game and test full gameplay by playing through all three standard objectives.
2. Verify desktop and mobile layouts in a live browser.
3. Check enemy spawning, boss spawn, victory timing, and defeat transitions.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Complete game implementation.
- `[screenshots/title.jpg]`: Latest visual verification screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game is served from the workspace root and can be opened via a local HTTP server.
- Desktop controls: WASD/arrows to move, Space to strike, Q for fireburst, E to rally, Shift to roll.
- Mobile controls include movement, rally, roll, fire, and strike buttons.
- Objective standards are located at (430,350), (1170,365), and (800,190).
- All changes are uncommitted.

Navigation:

Keyboard:

Mouse:

Save as:
